description: Pipefy work management platform: organizations, pipes (workflows), cards and phases through the GraphQL API. List the pipes an AI assistant can see, track cards as they move through phases, and read card field values.
instructions:
**Getting credentials**
1. Pipefy authenticates API calls with a bearer token. You can use a **Personal Access Token** (go to https://app.pipefy.com/tokens, "Generate new token", give it a description and save — use the longer token shown there) or a **Service Account** token (recommended for production, see the Authentication page in the Pipefy developer docs). Either way, set `PIPEFY_API_TOKEN`.
2. The adapter sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every call.

**Identifiers**
All Pipefy ids are numeric: a pipe id is the number in the pipe URL (e.g. `301234567` in `https://app.pipefy.com/pipes/301234567`), likewise card, phase and organization ids. Pass them as strings, e.g. `"301234567"`.

**Pagination and limits**
`pipefy_list_cards` pages with `first`/`after`: `first` caps the page (default 25, max 50 — the most Pipefy returns per request), and when `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is true, pass `pageInfo.endCursor` as `after` for the next page. Pipefy also enforces a monthly API-call quota that depends on the plan; one tool call is one API call.

**Common workflows**
- Explore: `pipefy_list_organizations` → `pipefy_list_pipes` (with an organization id) → `pipefy_get_pipe` (phases of one pipe).
- Track work: `pipefy_list_cards` (cards in a pipe, optionally paged) → `pipefy_get_card` (full field values of one card).
- Phase detail: `pipefy_get_phase` for a phase's card count and its fields.

**Limitations**
This adapter is read-only: it lists and inspects pipes, cards, phases and organizations. It does not create, move or update cards — Pipefy mutations are out of scope for this version. The `search` argument of the cards query is not exposed; page through `pipefy_list_cards` instead.
name: Pipefy

tools.description: List the organizations the token can see, with their id and name. The lightest call — it doubles as the auth check. Organization ids narrow pipefy_list_pipes.
tools.name: pipefy_list_organizations

tools.description: List the pipes (workflows) of one organization, with their id and name. Pipe ids narrow pipefy_get_pipe and pipefy_list_cards.

endpointMapping.path: query Pipes($orgId: ID!) { organization(id: $orgId) { id name pipes { id name } } }

tools.name: pipefy_list_pipes

org_id.description: Organization id, e.g. "123456" (the number in the organization URL). pipefy_list_organizations lists them.

tools.description: Show one pipe in full: id, name, card counts, its phases (id and name), the start-form fields and the labels. Use it to learn the phase ids before listing cards.

endpointMapping.path: query Pipe($pipeId: ID!) { pipe(id: $pipeId) { id name cards_count opened_cards_count phases { id name } start_form_fields { id label } labels { id name color } } }

tools.name: pipefy_get_pipe

pipe_id.description: Pipe id, e.g. "301234567" (the number in the pipe URL).

tools.description: List cards of one pipe, a page at a time: id, title, done flag, update time, current phase and assignees. Page with first/after — when pageInfo.hasNextPage is true, pass pageInfo.endCursor as after.

endpointMapping.path: query Cards($pipeId: ID!, $first: Int = 25, $after: String) { allCards(pipeId: $pipeId, first: $first, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } edges { node { id title done updated_at current_phase { id name } assignees { name email } } } } }

tools.name: pipefy_list_cards

after.description: Cursor for the next page: the pageInfo.endCursor of the previous call. Omit for the first page.

first.description: Cards per page (default 25, max 50 — the most Pipefy returns per request).

pipe_id.description: Pipe id, e.g. "301234567". pipefy_list_pipes lists them.

tools.description: Show one card in full: id, title, done flag, its pipe and current phase, every field with its name and value, and the assignees.

endpointMapping.path: query Card($cardId: ID!) { card(id: $cardId) { id title done updated_at pipe { id name } current_phase { id name } fields { name value filled_at } assignees { name email } } }

tools.name: pipefy_get_card

card_id.description: Card id, e.g. "123456789" (the number in the card URL).

tools.description: Show one phase: id, name, how many cards it holds, and the fields defined on it.

endpointMapping.path: query Phase($phaseId: ID!) { phase(id: $phaseId) { id name cards_count fields { id label } } }

tools.name: pipefy_get_phase

phase_id.description: Phase id, e.g. "12345678". pipefy_get_pipe lists a pipe's phases.
